cases.capability_title: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia – PATRIOT Advanced Capability-3 Missile Segment Enhancement Missiles
cases.source_item_enumeration: seven hundred thirty (730) PATRIOT Advanced Capability-3 Missile Segment Enhancement (PAC-3 MSE) missiles; plus non-MDE items as printed (launcher conversion kits; automated logistics systems kits; telemetry kits; shorting plug accumulation kit; missile skid kits; missiles round trainer; empty round trainer; spare parts; canister consumables; field surveillance program; integration and test support; munitions support; classified software delivery and support; publications; training; studies and surveys; contractor logistics support; USG and contractor support services; related program support)
cases.source_caveat: The description and dollar value are for the highest estimated quantity and dollar value based on initial requirements. Actual dollar value will be lower depending on final requirements, budget authority, and signed sales agreement(s), if and when concluded.

cases.capability_title: Sweden – M142 High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems
cases.source_item_enumeration: twenty (20) M142 high mobility artillery rocket systems; thirty-five (35) M31A2 GMLRS unitary pods with IMPS; thirty-five (35) M30A2 GMLRS AW pods with IMPS; thirty-five (35) M403 ER GMLRS AW pods with IMPS; thirty-five (35) M404 ER GMLRS unitary pods with IMPS; twenty (20) M57 ATACMS pods; twenty-four (24) international field artillery tactical data systems; plus non-MDE items as printed
cases.amount_source_text: The estimated total cost is $930 million.
cases.source_caveat_note: Census fact: State-era posts do not carry the DSCA-era 'highest estimated quantity' caveat paragraph; the caveat semantics are carried by the estimated_notification_value semantic itself and the card's standing negative (FREEZE §5). Null is the honest value — never synthesized.
